sentences.target: Hi!
sentences.literal: 嗨
sentences.note: 最随意通用的问候,任何场合都行;比 Hello 更口语。
sentences.ipa: haɪ

sentences.target: Good morning!
sentences.literal: 好的 早晨
sentences.note: 早上见面用;白天用 Good afternoon,傍晚用 Good evening。注意 Good night 是睡前/道别,不用来打招呼。
variants: A very good morning to you!
Top of the morning!(爱尔兰俏皮)
sentences.ipa: ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ

sentences.target: How are you?
sentences.literal: 怎么 是 你
sentences.note: 最常见寒暄;熟人之间也常说 How's it going? / What's up?。
sentences.ipa: haʊ ɑːr juː

sentences.target: I'm good, thanks. And you?
sentences.frame: I'm ___, thanks. And you?(good / fine / great)
sentences.literal: 我是 好,谢谢。还有 你?
sentences.note: 回答 How are you 的标准说法;口语 good / fine / great 都行。
variants: I'm fine, thanks. How about you?
sentences.ipa: aɪm ɡʊd θæŋks ænd juː

sentences.target: Nice to meet you.
sentences.literal: 高兴 去 见 你
sentences.note: 初次见面用 meet;再次见面改用 see。
variants: It's a pleasure to meet you.(正式)
sentences.ipa: naɪs tə miːt juː

sentences.target: Long time no see!
sentences.literal: 长 时间 没 见
sentences.note: 口语习惯说法,语法不规范但极常用;久别重逢时用。
variants: I haven't seen you in forever!
sentences.ipa: lɔːŋ taɪm noʊ siː

sentences.target: What's your name?
sentences.literal: 什么是 你的 名字
sentences.note: 问名字;May I have your name? 更礼貌正式。
variants: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
sentences.ipa: wʌts jʊr neɪm

sentences.target: I'm ___. / My name is ___.
sentences.literal: 我的 名字 是 ___
sentences.note: 自我介绍;口语里多用 I'm。
sentences.ipa: maɪ neɪm ɪz

sentences.target: Where are you from?
sentences.literal: 哪里 是 你 来自
sentences.note: 问来历;回答用 I'm from ___。
variants: What part of the world are you from?
sentences.ipa: wɛr ɑːr juː frʌm

sentences.target: See you later!
sentences.literal: 见 你 稍后
sentences.note: 随意道别;正式场合可用 Goodbye。
sentences.ipa: siː juː ˈleɪtər

sentences.target: Hi there! Do you have a reservation?
sentences.literal: 嗨 那里!做 你 有 一 预订
sentences.note: 对方:领位员的开场白。
variants: Welcome! Do you have a booking?
sentences.ipa: hˈaɪ ðˈɛɹ dˈuː juː hæv ɐ ɹˌɛzɚvˈeɪʃən

sentences.native: 没有。要一张两人桌,谢谢。
sentences.target: No, we don't. A table for two, please.
sentences.literal: 不,我们 不。一张 桌子 给 两个,请
sentences.note: 你:告知没预订并说明人数。
variants: Could we get a table for two?
Do you have a table for two?
sentences.ipa: nˈoʊ wiː dˈoʊnt ɐ tˈeɪbəl fɔːɹ tˈuː plˈiːz

sentences.native: 好的,这边请。这是您的桌子。
sentences.target: Sure, right this way. Here's your table.
sentences.literal: 当然,正 这 方向。这里是 你的 桌子
sentences.note: 对方:领位引导就座,'right this way' 很高频。
variants: Let me show you to your table.
Take a seat wherever you like.
sentences.ipa: ʃˈʊɹ ɹˈaɪt ðɪs wˈeɪ hˈɪɹz jʊɹ tˈeɪbəl

sentences.target: Can I start you off with something to drink?
sentences.frame: Can I start you off with ___?
sentences.literal: 能 我 开始 你 用 某物 去 喝
sentences.note: 对方:服务员餐厅高频句,先问饮品。
variants: What can I get you to drink?
Would you like a drink to start?
sentences.ipa: kæn aɪ stˈɑːɹt juː ˈɔf wɪð sˈʌmθɪŋ tə dɹˈɪŋk

sentences.target: Could I get some water, please?
sentences.frame: Could I get some ___, please?(water / bread)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 拿 一些 水,请
sentences.note: 你:点饮品。对方可能反问 Still or sparkling?(平水还是气泡水)。
variants: Could we see the drinks menu?
sentences.ipa: kʊd aɪ ɡɛt sˌʌm wˈɔːɾɚ plˈiːz

sentences.target: Could I see the menu, please?
sentences.frame: Could I ___, please?(see the menu / order)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 看 这 菜单,请
sentences.note: 你:要菜单。Could I 比 Can I 更礼貌。
variants: Can I have the menu, please?
Do you have a menu in English?
sentences.ipa: kʊd aɪ sˈiː ðə mˈɛnjuː plˈiːz

sentences.native: 当然。今日特餐是烤三文鱼。
sentences.target: Of course. Today's special is the grilled salmon.
sentences.literal: 当然。今天的 特色 是 这 烤 三文鱼
sentences.note: 对方:递菜单并介绍当日特餐(special)。
variants: Our most popular dish is the steak.
sentences.ipa: ʌv kˈɔːɹs tədˈeɪz spˈɛʃəl ɪz ðə ɡɹˈɪld sˈæmən

sentences.target: What do you recommend?
sentences.frame: What do you recommend ___?(for a starter)
sentences.literal: 什么 做 你 推荐
sentences.note: 你:向服务员问招牌菜。
sentences.ipa: wˌʌt dˈuː juː ɹˌɛkəmˈɛnd

sentences.target: Are you ready to order?
sentences.literal: 是 你 准备好 去 点
sentences.note: 对方:服务员询问是否点餐。
variants: What can I get for you?
sentences.ipa: ɑːɹ juː ɹˈɛdi tʊ ˈɔːɹdɚ

sentences.target: I'll have this one, please.
sentences.literal: 我将 有 这 一个,请
sentences.note: 你:点菜最常用句型;指着菜单说 this one 很方便。
sentences.ipa: aɪl hæv ðˈɪswˌʌn plˈiːz

sentences.native: 我对花生过敏。这道菜里有什么?
sentences.target: I'm allergic to peanuts. What's in this dish?
sentences.literal: 我是 过敏的 对 花生。什么 在 这 菜里
sentences.note: 你:主动告知过敏并问配料,很重要。
variants: Does this have meat in it?
sentences.ipa: aɪm ɐlˈɜːdʒɪk tə pˈiːnʌts wˌʌts ɪn ðɪs dˈɪʃ

sentences.native: 这道没有花生。还要别的吗?
sentences.target: No peanuts in that. Anything else?
sentences.literal: 没 花生 在 那。任何 别的
sentences.note: 对方:确认并追问是否还要别的。
variants: Would you like a side with that?
sentences.ipa: nˈoʊ pˈiːnʌts ɪn ðˈæt ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls

sentences.target: That's everything, thanks.
sentences.literal: 那 是 一切,谢谢
sentences.note: 你:表示点完了。
sentences.ipa: ðæts ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ θˈæŋks

sentences.target: How is everything?
sentences.literal: 怎么 是 一切
sentences.note: 对方:用餐中服务员常来问。
variants: Can I get you anything else?
sentences.ipa: hˌaʊ ɪz ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ

sentences.target: That was delicious, thank you!
sentences.literal: 那 是 美味的,谢谢
sentences.note: 你:称赞菜好吃。
sentences.ipa: ðæt wʌz dᵻlˈɪʃəs θˈæŋk juː

sentences.target: Could we get the check, please?
sentences.frame: Could we get the ___, please?(check / bill)
sentences.literal: 可以 我们 拿 这 账单,请
sentences.note: 你:结账。美式说 check,英式说 bill。
variants: Can we have the bill, please?
sentences.ipa: kʊd wiː ɡɛt ðə tʃˈɛk plˈiːz

sentences.target: Sure. Together or separate?
sentences.literal: 当然。一起 或者 分开
sentences.note: 对方:结账时常问是否分账。
sentences.ipa: ʃˈʊɹ təɡˌɛðɚɹ ɔːɹ sˈɛpɹət

sentences.target: Together, please. Can I pay by card?
sentences.literal: 一起,请。可以 我 付 用 卡
sentences.note: 你:选一起付并问支付方式。AA 分账说 split the bill。
sentences.ipa: təɡˈɛðɚ plˈiːz kæn aɪ pˈeɪ baɪ kˈɑːɹd

sentences.target: Of course. Have a great evening!
sentences.literal: 当然。有 一个 很棒的 晚上
sentences.note: 对方:告别祝福。回一句 “Thanks, you too!”。
sentences.ipa: ʌv kˈɔːɹs hæv ɐ ɡɹˈeɪt ˈiːvnɪŋ

sentences.native: 你好!需要帮您找什么吗?
sentences.target: Hi! Can I help you find anything?
sentences.literal: 嗨!能 我 帮 你 找到 任何东西
sentences.note: 对方:店员的开场招呼。
variants: Hi there, are you looking for anything in particular?
Let me know if you need any help.
How can I help you today?
sentences.ipa: hˈaɪ kæn aɪ hˈɛlp juː fˈaɪnd ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ

sentences.target: I'm just looking, thanks.
sentences.literal: 我是 只是 看,谢谢
sentences.note: 你:暂不需要帮忙的礼貌回应。
variants: I'll let you know if I need help.
sentences.ipa: aɪm dʒˈʌst lˈʊkɪŋ θˈæŋks

sentences.target: Actually, how much is this?
sentences.literal: 其实,多少 是 这个
sentences.note: 你:问价最常用;复数用 How much are these?。
sentences.ipa: ˈæktʃuːəli hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ ɪz ðˈɪs

sentences.target: That one's twenty-five dollars. It's on sale.
sentences.literal: 那 一个是 二十五 美元。它是 在 打折
sentences.note: 对方:报价并说明是否打折(on sale)。
sentences.ipa: ðæt wˈʌnz twˈɛntifˈaɪv dˈɑːlɚz ɪts ˌɔn sˈeɪl

sentences.target: Can I try this on?
sentences.literal: 可以 我 试 这 上身
sentences.note: 你:试衣专用,try ... on 是固定搭配。
variants: Is it okay to try this on?
sentences.ipa: kæn aɪ tɹˈaɪ ðɪs ˈɔn

sentences.target: Sure, the fitting room is right over there.
sentences.literal: 当然,这 试衣间 是 正 在 那边
sentences.note: 对方:指引试衣间方向。
variants: The changing rooms are at the back.
sentences.ipa: ʃˈʊɹ ðə fˈɪɾɪŋ ɹˈuːm ɪz ɹˈaɪt ˌoʊvɚ ðˈɛɹ

sentences.target: Do you have this in a bigger size?
sentences.frame: Do you have this in ___?(a bigger size / blue)
sentences.literal: 有 你 这个 在 更大 号
sentences.note: 你:问尺码/颜色;小一号用 a smaller size。
variants: Do you have a larger size?
Does this come in a medium?
Do you have this in another color?
sentences.ipa: dˈuː juː hæv ðɪs ɪn ɐ bˈɪɡɚ sˈaɪz

sentences.target: Let me check the back for you.
sentences.frame: Let me ___ for you.(check the back)
sentences.literal: 让 我 查 这 后面 给 你
sentences.note: 对方:店员去库房查货。
variants: Let me see what we have.
One moment, I'll have a look.
I'll check if we have it in stock.
sentences.ipa: lˈɛt mˌiː tʃˈɛk ðə bˈæk fɔːɹ juː

sentences.target: Here you go — a medium.
sentences.literal: 这里 你 去 —— 一个 中码
sentences.note: 对方:把找到的商品递给你。
variants: Sorry, that's the only size left.
We've got it in medium and large.
sentences.ipa: hˈɪɹ juː ɡˈoʊ ɐ mˈiːdiəm

sentences.target: I'll take this one. Do you take card?
sentences.literal: 我将 拿 这 一个。你 收 卡 吗
sentences.note: 你:决定购买并问支付方式。take / accept 都可以。
sentences.ipa: aɪl tˈeɪk ðˈɪswˌʌn dˈuː juː tˈeɪk kˈɑːɹd

sentences.target: Yes, card or contactless is fine.
sentences.literal: 是,卡 或 非接触 是 可以
sentences.note: 对方:确认支付方式。contactless = 感应/碰一下支付。
variants: Sure, you can tap to pay.
sentences.ipa: jˈɛs kˈɑːɹd ɔːɹ kˈɑːntæktləs ɪz fˈaɪn

sentences.target: Could I get a bag, please?
sentences.frame: Could I get a ___, please?(bag / receipt)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 拿 一个 袋子,请
sentences.note: 你:要袋子。很多地方袋子收费。
variants: Could you put it in a bag?
sentences.ipa: kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ɐ bˈæɡ plˈiːz

sentences.native: 袋子收10美分。还要别的吗?
sentences.target: That'll be ten cents for the bag. Anything else?
sentences.literal: 那 将是 十 美分 为 这 袋子。任何 别的
sentences.note: 对方:告知袋子收费并问是否还要别的。
sentences.ipa: ðˌæɾəl biː tˈɛn sˈɛnts fɚðə bˈæɡ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls

sentences.target: Can I return this if it doesn't fit?
sentences.literal: 可以 我 退 这个 如果 它 不 合适
sentences.note: 你:退货用 return,换货用 exchange;通常需要 receipt。
sentences.ipa: kæn aɪ ɹᵻtˈɜːn ðɪs ɪf ɪt dˈʌzənt fˈɪt

sentences.native: 可以,留好小票就行。祝您愉快!
sentences.target: Sure, just keep your receipt. Have a good one!
sentences.literal: 当然,只 留 你的 小票。有 一个 好的 一天
sentences.note: 对方:说明退货需留小票并道别。回 “Thanks, you too!”。
variants: You can return it within 30 days.
sentences.ipa: ʃˈʊɹ dʒˈʌst kˈiːp jʊɹ ɹᵻsˈiːt hæv ɐ ɡˈʊd wˌʌn

sentences.target: Thanks, you too!
sentences.literal: 谢谢,你 也
sentences.note: 你:回应对方的祝福,自然收尾。
sentences.ipa: θˈæŋks juː tˈuː
